supervision.mechanism: True child process group via subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True), periodic parent supervision loop, os.killpg termination (SIGTERM -> SIGKILL), POSIX empty group proof

pre_reservation_rejection.mechanism: Approval, statistical protocol JSON, weights manifest, views quota, cumulative budget, and worker runner prerequisites checked BEFORE touching RunStore

readonly_inspect.mechanism: Direct SQLite URI mode=ro query avoiding RunStore initialization, DDL execution, or table metadata mutations

ledger_query_and_fail_closed.mechanism: Corrected column to active_seconds; damaged/abnormal ledgers fail closed with BenchmarkRefusalError instead of returning 0.0

cumulative_views_accounting.mechanism: Enforced lifetime 64-view cumulative quota across all derived jobs in RunStore; rejects if cumulative_views + requested_views > 64

mutation_controls.name: Control 1: Wall Clock Timeout Supervision Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Normal execution within budget -> returncode=0, violation=None
mutation_controls.mutated: Runaway worker (sleep 5.0s > 0.2s budget) -> killed by supervisor, violation=timeout, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 2: Process Group RSS Protection Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Normal memory allocation (5 MiB <= 50 MiB) -> returncode=0
mutation_controls.mutated: Runaway memory (100 MiB > 30 MiB limit) -> killed by supervisor, violation=rss_limit, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 3: Orphan Grandchild Leak Detection Gate
mutation_controls.mutated: Group leader exits early leaving background grandchild -> killed by supervisor, violation=grandchild_leak, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 4: Corrupt Ledger Fail-Closed Protection Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Valid SQLite ledger -> read-only inspect computes accurate active_seconds and cumulative_views
mutation_controls.mutated: Corrupted or non-SQLite file -> fails closed raising BenchmarkRefusalError, strictly no fallback to 0.0
